style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.mf_moon_shrieks: Night over Wickermoor's clocktower, the huge crooked moon with its mouth torn open wide
pictures.mf_moon_shrieks_2: Townsfolk in the street looking up at the moon, some kneeling, lanterns forgotten in their hands
pictures.mf_headsman_reveals: A headless centaur executioner bursting out of a covered bridge's dark mouth, a burning axe raised
pictures.mf_headsman_reveals_2: A flaming skull flying ahead of the rider down a moonlit road of corn
pictures.mf_headsman_falls: A fallen rider's flame guttering out on an old bridge, the corn behind it letting go of the ground
pictures.mf_headsman_falls_2: The huge moon turning its gaze slowly west over a black lake
pictures.mf_worm_reveals: A vast pale worm rising from a tear in the air over black lake water, its mouth a ring of soft teeth
pictures.mf_worm_reveals_2: A choir of white worms in the water, all turning toward a jetty
pictures.mf_worm_falls: A great pale worm falling back through a closing rift in the air, the lake still as glass
pictures.mf_worm_falls_2: The moon turning its gaze north over a dark forest
pictures.mf_tall_man_reveals: An impossibly tall thin figure unfolding between the pillars of a ruined palace, head bowed beneath the roof
pictures.mf_tall_man_reveals_2: A long hand reaching, and the shadows of a dark wood standing up to follow it
pictures.mf_tall_man_falls: A tall thin figure collapsing like a dropped puppet in a ruined hall, its shadows lying down
pictures.mf_tall_man_falls_2: The moon turning its gaze slowly north toward snowy mountains
pictures.mf_titan_reveals: A giant of rock, root and ice rising over a mountain summit, its fists the size of cottages
pictures.mf_titan_reveals_2: A roar rolling down a snow slope and a rockfall following it
pictures.mf_titan_falls: A giant of stone sitting down slowly on a summit like a mountain settling, its arms hanging
pictures.mf_titan_falls_2: The moon turning its gaze south and east over a cemetery's open graves
pictures.mf_barrow_reveals: A king in black armour with a crown of bone rising from a throne of skulls, sword drawn, ranks of the dead behind him
pictures.mf_barrow_reveals_2: A hall of standing wights turning as one toward the door
pictures.mf_barrow_falls: A bone crown rolling ringing across a stone floor as armour falls to dust
pictures.mf_barrow_falls_2: The moon turning its gaze south toward swamplights in a marsh
pictures.mf_leviathan_reveals: A colossal alligator breaking the surface of a black pool, wearing a crown of old hexes, grinning
pictures.mf_leviathan_reveals_2: Swamplights winking out and on across a bayou as its jaws open
pictures.mf_leviathan_falls: A colossal alligator sinking into a black pool, the swamplights going out one by one
pictures.mf_leviathan_falls_2: The moon turning its gaze south and west toward a forest of spiders
pictures.mf_dusk_reveals: A weeping shade in white at a great loom, huge shears in her hands and a doll hanging from each finger
pictures.mf_dusk_reveals_2: Hundreds of dolls on shelves in a hall, all turning their painted faces
pictures.mf_dusk_falls: A pair of huge shears falling and a white shape dissolving into thread and dust
pictures.mf_dusk_falls_2: A hut's window with a small candle lit in it, and children's laughter somehow visible as warm light
pictures.mf_rowans_erupts: A hill bursting open into a volcano over a moor, red light pouring out
pictures.mf_rowans_erupts_2: Winged fiends rising from rivers of lava over the dark moors
pictures.mf_behemoth_reveals: A mountainous fiend of horn and flame climbing out of a volcano's crater, wings of smoke across the sky
pictures.mf_behemoth_reveals_2: The moor lit red by its breath, a line of tiny cultists kneeling
pictures.mf_behemoth_falls: A mountainous fiend sinking into lava as the sky above the crater begins to clear
pictures.mf_behemoth_falls_2: The huge moon hanging low over a hill, looking down, smiling
pictures.mf_one_last_choice: The giant moon a few hundred feet above a hill, roofs and trees tearing loose into the gale toward it
pictures.mf_one_last_choice_2: The crone's face in the crescent speaking, her lips shaping words
pictures.mf_offer_refused: The huge moon lifting away from the Hollow like a lid, its face softening and fading
pictures.mf_offer_refused_2: The stars coming back one by one over a calm village, the crescent hanging without a face
pictures.mf_offer_accepted: The moon coming down on a land like a hand closing, everything going white
pictures.mf_offer_accepted_2: Four small figures floating alone in a sea of green light
pictures.mf_moon_impact: The huge moon filling the whole sky, the night gone white from edge to edge
pictures.mf_moon_impact_2: A silent empty crater where a village had been, and a sneering moon gone
pictures.mf_train_out: A lit train pulling out of the fog and a frogman in a wide hat taking it off to a village
pictures.mf_train_out_2: The huge moon sagging lower over rooftops, the last lamp in a square going out
